title: Ansel and the Tryouts
author: Jude Pemberton
blurb: Juniper Ashgrove, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before the last game of the season.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
